desc: ESO / DOB on URB -- linear ADRC. paper/BASELINES.md B10.
This arm does not learn: there is no network, no optimiser and no reward
anywhere in it. The host block is iql/config1.json and is only read for the
epsilon-greedy schedule (eps_init / eps_decay / eps_min), which supplies
the excitation a control law does not have on a discrete choice; those
three values are iql/config1.json's. training_eps and the rest are kept
so the arm runs for the same number of days as every other.
arm = eso1   B10's 'first-order observer ... one gain'.
beta = 0.5   the one gain: an observer time constant of about two days,
far faster than the 100-day weather cycle and slower than daily
noise. Declared, never tuned on returns.
omega = 0.5  the second-order (eso2) bandwidth, Gao's parameterisation
beta1 = 2*omega, beta2 = omega^2 with h = 1 day.
